subject: Multi-prospect demo ops check-in and waitlist plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Liu <sam@acme.com>, Tina Morales <tina@nimbushealth.com>, EdgeRetail Sales <sales@edgeretail.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Multi-prospect demo ops check-in and waitlist plan

Hi all —

Thanks for signing up for the joint office-hours/demo next week. A few ops notes before I send the calendar invites so we don’t overbook the room: we have capacity for 10 live seats (one host + one co-host + 8 attendee spots). I want to propose the following and confirm whether your teams are comfortable with a waitlist/record-and-1:1 fallback.

Proposed live slots (pick one):
- Wed Nov 25, 6:00–6:45 PM PT / Thu Nov 26, 2:00–2:45 AM CET (evening US / late EU)
- Thu Nov 26, 7:30–8:15 PM PT / Fri Nov 27, 3:30–4:15 AM CET (alternate night)

Key asks from prospects:
- If you need a pre-demo tech sync, add a quick note (we can do a 15m prior call)
- If your team cannot make a live slot, we’ll put you on the waitlist and share the recording + offer follow-up 1:1.

Attachments: Group_Demo_Agenda.pdf (5–10 minute topics per product area), Demo_Capacity_Roster.csv (internal ops only).

Links: calendar poll here -> https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=examplepoll. Deck link for reference: https://drive.google.com/document/d/example-demo-deck

I’ll finalize after you reply with preferred slot (or if you want the waitlist). Ops team, can you confirm host availability and recording slot?

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com

From: Sam Liu <sam@acme.com>

Subject: Re: Multi-prospect demo ops check-in and waitlist plan

> Thanks for signing up for the joint office-hours/demo next week.

Hi Jordan — thanks for coordinating. Acme can do the first slot (Wed Nov 25, 6:00 PM PT). One ask: we have a short compliance question about data retention in private deployments — could we tack on a 10–15 minute tech pre-call before the demo (say 5:30 PM PT) so our engineering lead can check specifics? If that works, please count us in for one live seat.

Also, if the session is recorded, please share the recording and a quick note of the timestamps for the retention question.

Best,

Head of Platform, Acme Corp
sam@acme.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Multi-prospect demo ops check-in and waitlist plan

Jordan — quick ops triage:

- Confirmed capacity: 10 live seats as noted. We should assign Marissa as host (she’s available Wed 6p PT) and Priyom as breakout/1:1 lead for follow-ups.
- Pre-demo 15m tech call is fine (we’ll open a separate meeting link for those who ask). Sam — we can block 5:30–5:45 PM PT as the pre-call; Marissa, can you join?
- Waitlist flow: once 8 attendee seats are filled, remaining registrants are automatically placed on the waitlist and receive the recording within 24 hours. For high-intent accounts (ACV > $100k) we’ll prioritize a guaranteed 1:1 within 72 hours instead of only the recording. Please flag anything that looks like high intent.

Operational asks:
- Jordan: send the calendar invite with the final slot and specify the pre-demo tech call option (5:30 PT). Include the recording + 1:1 pledge in the event description.
- Priyom: prep a short breakout template (10–15m) we can use for follow-ups.
- Marissa: confirm you can host + record.

Attachments: Demo_Capacity_Roster.csv (internal)

Thanks —
Ben
Customer Success Ops, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Liu <sam@acme.com>, Tina Morales <tina@nimbushealth.com>, EdgeRetail Sales <sales@edgeretail.io>

Subject: Final: Wed Nov 25 6:00 PM PT joint demo — pre-call option + waitlist details

Thanks everyone — finalizing the invite for Wed Nov 25, 6:00–6:45 PM PT. Sam, I’ve added the 5:30–5:45 PM PT pre-demo tech slot for your team; you should see a separate calendar invite for that in a few minutes.

What to expect in the live session:
- 5 min quick intros
- 20 min product walkthrough (serving/runtime + deployment modes)
- 10 min focused Q&A (retention/compliance question will be triaged first)
- 10 min next-steps/1:1 signups

Recording & waitlist flow:
- We will record and distribute within 24 hours.
- Waitlist folks will receive the recording automatically and a link to sign up for a prioritized 1:1 if flagged as high intent.

Links & attachments:
- Calendar event / RSVP: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=examplepoll
- Deck: https://drive.google.com/document/d/example-demo-deck
- Internal ops roster (for reference): Demo_Capacity_Roster.csv

Owners: Marissa (host + recording), Priyom (follow-up templates). Ben — please confirm the recording settings and that the event is set to auto-email the recording to registrants.

Looking forward — see you Wednesday.

—
